##### **Executive Summary** 

##### **Highlights of international copper market** 

In Q1 2012, global r

efined copper output reached 5.02Mt, up by 7.8% y-o-y or up by 2.2% q-o-q; global consumption was 4.9Mt, up by 4.4% y-o-y or up by 2.2% q-o-q. The growth rate of global refined copper output was higher than that of consumption, the global supply surplus further expanded, and the supply and demand level in Jan.-Mar. 2012 was in a slight surplus state. 

Global copper-in-concentrate output is expected to increase by 4% y-o-y or 4% q-o-q to 3.2Mt in Q1 2012, global consumption increased to 3.27Mt, up by 7.6% y-o-y or up by 3% q-o-q. Global copper-in-concentrate market still maintained a supply gap and the gap was about 70kt. 

##### **Global refined copper output up in Q1** 

In Q1 2012, although global capacity utilization rate was not high, due to the expanding projects, copper output still increased, of which, output of China, USA, Chile, Peru, Mexico, Zambia and India increased by different degrees. 

In respect of consumption, Chinese demand was still weak, demand in German and Italy was also weak, that of USA resumed compared with H2 2011, but y-o-y gap was still existed, copper demand in second and third line countries kept normal level or slightly increases, some compensated the loss of first line countries. 

In Q1 2012, global refined copper output reached 5.02Mt, up by 7.8% y-o-y or up by 2.2% q-o-q; global consumption was 4.9Mt, up by 4.4% y-o-y or up by 2.2% q-o-q. The growth rate of global refined copper output was higher than that of consumption, the global supply surplus further expanded, and the supply and demand level in Jan.-Mar. 2012 was in a slight surplus state. 

Chinese demand will be limited in Q2 and the surplus will be still expanded. However, the consumption is expected to be resumed and demand in European developed countries will be slowly recovered, which will support copper price.

##### **Global copper concentrate supply slightly up** 

In Q1 2012, big global strike was few, BHP Billiton and Rio Tinto even passed the plan to expand Escondida Copper Mine with investment of US$4.5bln, and BHP Billiton expressed that it would restart copper mines in America, because they were optimistic about demand in China. Overall, global copper concentrate output slightly increased in Q1. 

In respect of consumption, Chinese smelters had strong demand and import of copper-in-concentrate still maintained at a high level. If there is no gap between domestic and overseas, the demand may be better. Demand in other countries basically kept stable or increased slightly. 

TC/RCs in Q1 2012 cont

inued to increased, but the number was not too high, Chinese smelters lifted the TC/RCs from US$30-40 per tonne/3.0-4.0cent per lb to US$40-50 per tonne/4.0-5.0cent per lb, some international smelters even was lower than this level. 

Global copper-in-concentrate output is expected to increase by 4% y-o-y or 4% q-o-q to 3.2Mt in Q1 2012, global consumption increased to 3.27Mt, up by 7.6% y-o-y or up by 3% q-o-q. Global copper-in-concentrate market still maintained a supply gap and the gap was about 70kt. 

Global copper-in-concentrate output in 2012 is expected to be slightly affected by low ore grade, but due to the decrease of strike, copper-in-concentrate will increase in 2012. 

Global copper-in-concentrate is expected to reach 12.97Mt in 2012, up by 5.0% y-o-y; but with the expansion of Chinese smelting capacity, the supply gap will continue to enlarge.

##### **Highlights of Chinese copper market** 

In Q1 2012, average copper price and 3-month price on SHFE was 59,239yuan/t and 59,506yuan/t, up by 5.50% and 6.27% q-o-q or down by 17.33% and 17.43% y-o-y, respectively, in respect of average price, the growth rate of domestic price was obviously weaker than global price. 

In Q1, refined copper import had a great year-on-year rise, but production maintained a moderate increase. Copper consumption growth continued to slowdown, which led to large 

5 

supply surplus in domestic copper market. Refined copper production increased by 8.1% to 1330kt in Q1. Refined copper import sharply increased by 76.3% to 1051kt, while export close to zero. Refined copper consumption slightly rose to 1.77Mt in Q1, up by 4.1% y/y. Refined copper supply surplus was about 582kt in Q1, while at 20kt in Q1 of 2011. 

Antaike estimates that domestic refined copper production in 2012 will be about 5.70Mt, at a rise of 10% y/y; refined copper consumption increased by 5% to 7.7Mt; refined copper import will keep at a relative high level. So it is expected that refined copper supply will be in a large surplus in 2012. 

##### **Chinese Copper Price** 

##### **Copper price is declining** 

In Jan. 2012, copper prices fluctuated and increased severely. Copper price hit record high in early Feb. according to “at least not raise interest rate before 2014 to support the recovery of economy”, but it lacked of further upward momentum, which fluctuated between US$8,200 and US$8,700. Average copper prices and 3 month price on LME in Q1 2012 was US$8,307/t and US$8312/t, up by 10.94% and 10.67% q-o-q compared with Q4 201

1 or down by 13.92% and 13.81% y-o-y, respectively. Copper price on SHFE in Q1 followed the trend with LME market, it exceeded 61,000yuan/t before Spring Festival, but the ratio dropped below 7.1 after Spring Festival, although copper price increased to 62,000yuan/t, hitting a new record, the ratio has not been restored to the level of pre-holiday due to the weak pattern; in Mar. 2012, the ratio has slightly restored compared with Spring Festival, but still lower than normal level. In Q1 2012, average copper price and 3 month price on SHFE was 59,239yuan/t and 59,506yuan/t, up by 5.50% and 6.27% q-o-q or down by 17.33% and 17.43% y-o-y, respectively, in respect of average price, the growth rate of domestic price was obviously weaker than global price. **Table 3 Average Copper Price on LME and SHFE** ||**LME(U**

--> ##### **Copper inventory changes on LME and SHFE** In Mar. 2012, copper inventory on LME decreased to 254kt, touching the lowest since Nov. 7, 2008, equivalent to the global demand for 5 days, meanwhile, the proportion of canceled 7 warrants in inventory was still above 30%. (The average value was no more than 5% in past five years) Some good news about supply aspect, such as: Mr. Diego Hemandez, as the CEO of the global largest copper producer Codelco, said it is not easy for the company to produce 1.74Mt copper in 2012 and the copper supply for 2012 would still be limited; Freeport-McMoRan’s Grasberg Copper Mine occurred violence and strikes again in late Feb. However, the reason for the decrease of inventory on LME was just the transfer of stock from LME to SHFE, the real demand in China was weaker than market expectation and a large amount of import copper transferred to inventory. Furthermore when LME canceled warrants and inventory decreased, the stock mainly transferred to developed industrial areas in New Orleans, USA, in the meanwhile, the copper inventory on New York COMEX increased. All showed that the reason for the decrease of copper inventory on LME was not consumption but the transfer of stock. Copper inventory on SHFE increased to above 220kt, touching the highest level since 2002. Since H2 2011, the increase of import has not quickly transferred to consumption but become the inventory, which limited the growth of copper price. Since 2012, the inventory on Shanghai bonded area will increase consciously and it exceeded 600kt recently, which showed large amounts of copper were piled in warehouse. The FOB premium on Shanghai port decreased to US$40-50/t, thus the real demand also decreased. Import in Q2 is expected to decrease and will bring out great pressure on copper price. **Chart 2 Inventory on LME and SHFE and Closing Price of LME 3-M Cu** 600000 10500

8 ##### **Sulfuric acid prices maintains stable** According to data from the NBS, domestic sulfuric acid production accumulated to 11.52Mt during Jan to Feb, slightly up by 3.67% y/y. Domestic sulfuric acid prices fluctuated down in Q1 of 2012, with quarterly average price of 414 yuan/t, down by 31.34% y/y. The main reasons for the growth rate decline are as follows: first, fertilizing period in spring is delayed due to weather conditions in Chinese Northeast areas, which led to demand fall for sulfuric acid; second, phosphate fertilizer export carried out season tariff of 110%, which made phosphate f

ertilizer unable to realize the big export and resulted in large supply surplus in domestic market; third; impacted by lower prices of smelting sulfuric acid, sulfuric acid producers who used sulfur as raw materials was in shutdown in South China, reflecting weak demand for sulfuric acid in South China; four, imported sulfur prices dropped in Q1 compared with that in Q4 of 2011, which pulled down sulfuric acid prices. 

In Q2 of 2012, most of domestic phosphate fertilizer will be collected in port and be waiting for export, which will stimulate demand for sulfuric acid as operating rate getting better in Chinese phosphate fertilizer enterprises. Rise of export benchmark price for phosphate fertilizer will be good for phosphate fertilizer export. In the whole, supply surplus of domestic sulfuric acid will continue to exist and phosphate fertilizer prices will show a rising wave for a certain period, driven by phosphate fertilizer export. It is expected for quarterly average price of domestic sulfuric acid to be 450-500yuan/t.

##### **Chinese Copper Material Supply** 

##### **Mining capacity** 

Domestic copper concentrate capacity, which will be completed and put into operation, will be 100ktpy or above in 2012, including several expansion projects in Jiangxi Copper Co. and Duomaoshang Mine Deposit of Zijinshan Mining. Domestic actually newly-added copper concentrate capacity will be about 70kt in 2012, because Dexing Copper Mine’s expansion project has been put into operation in succession since 2009. Chinese mining expansion projects under construction are as follows: 

**Xinxin Mining Co., Ltd** ’s Huangshan Cu-Ni Mine’s 4,000t/d project started in June, 2010. The mine locates in Hami City, Xinjiang with 84Mt of Cu-Ni ore reserves, including 380kt of nickel content, 220kt of copper content and 32kt of cobalt content. The project with total investment of 1bln yuan will be commissioned in H1 2012. 

**Jiangxi Copper** ’s Dexing Copper Mine expansion project is expected to be finished completely in 2012 on schedule. Overall investment budget will reach 2.7bln yuan. After the whole project being commissioned, its mining capacity will rise to 130kt/d from current 100kt/d. Newly-added output will include 41kt copper-in-concentrate, 61kg gold and 25t silver. 

**Chengmenshan Copper Mine** ’s stage 2 of expansion project was kicked off in December, 2009. The stage 2 with investment of 500mln yuan will be constructed for 2 years, which has been put into production at the end of 2011. Project can process 7000t/d of ores and produce 14.8kt/y of copper after it reaches the designed capacity. **Jiangxi Yinshan Mining Co., Ltd** ’s 5,000t/d mining project with total investment of 500mln yuan started in 2010. After completion, it is expected to produce 6,821t metal copper. The project has been put into trial run at the end of 2011. **Jiangxi Copper** planned to produce 210kt copper –in-conce

ntrate in 2012, up by 3.96% compared with 202kt in 2011, considerably lower than 17.44% of 2011. 

**Zinjin Mining Holdings Group Co., Ltd** ’s Zinjinshan Copper Mine with total investment of 582mln yuan will establish two ore dressing plants which can process 10kt/d and 8,000t/d of ores respectively. And it will also establish a 45kt/d grinding system project. Reconstruction and follow-up reformation project of Zijinshan hydrometallurgy plant has been basically finished and most of the project will be put into operation before the end of 2012. 

**Tuwu Copper Mine** , in Hami, Xinjiang Autonomous Region, started construction on Feb. 25, 2010. The project is planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage will adopt open pit method and underground mining method. Stage 1 is planned to be finished in 2011 as schedule. After that it will be capable of processing 5kt ores per day in stage 1, and the processing capacity will be expanded to 10kt in stage 2. The project is invested by Xinjiang Huajin Copper Co., Ltd. under Central Asia Yanxin Copper Co., Ltd. 

Heilongjiang **Duobaoshan Copper-Molybdenum Mine** is invested by Heilongjiang Duobaoshan Copper Co., Ltd. (Duobaoshan Copper) with a total investment of 3.0bln yuan 

10 

and planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage is designed to be commissioned by the end of 2011 and now will be put off till to first half of 2012. After that it will be capable of processing 25kt ores per day, and producing 117,648t copper concentrates (25% Cu, about 30kt metal copper) and 1,401t molybdenum concentrates (45% Mo) per year.  When the second stage being commissioned, 50kt ores can be processed per day, and outputs of copper concentrates (25% Cu) and molybdenum concentrates (45%) will reach 233,316t and 3,014 t respectively. Time table of stage 2 has not been revealed. 

**Xinjiang Hudehe Copper mine** 's 6Mtpy copper mining project kicked off on Sep. 16, 2011, which is a large-scale porphyry copper deposit in Toli County, Tacheng Prefecture, Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, with proven reserve was 362.5kt metal copper, and 1Mt prospective reserve. The preliminary scheme is to complete 6Mtpy mining project, with total investment budget of 1.466 bln yuan. After being put into production, the project is estimated to produce 15kt copper-in-concentrate. 

**Tongling Tongshan Mining Company** ’s deep mining project started in early September. The project’s designed ores processing capacity is 2kt/d and 660kt/y. The project is designed to produce 5kt copper per year. It is estimated to be completed by the end of 2013.

Antaike estimates that domestic refined copper production in 2012 will be about 5.70Mt, at a rise of 10% y/y; refined copper consumption increased by 5% to 7.7Mt; refined copper import will keep at a relative high level.
